title: Opensignal's November 2026 India Fixed Broadband Experience report (data 1 Apr–29 Jun 2026, published 11 Nov): Airtel ahead on all five overall measures; on wired broadband Airtel 26–27% faster than Jio on download and upload, BSNL 0.5/0.8 Mbps behind Airtel, Jio slowest of the three on wired speed at 30.5/21.0 Mbps; reliability Airtel 486, Jio 423, BSNL 419; fixed wireless Airtel 32.4/20.7 vs Jio 25.7/17.1 Mbps, reliability 450 vs 382; Jio has about 9.4 million of India's 13.5 million 5G FWA connections (TRAI, Aug 2026)
